reviews.title: Favorite thing
reviews.text: I look forward to doing this app every day- at first I just tried to do once a week but then I found that I wanted to do it more. I am almost 52 yo and I have had six children - now as a grandmother, I am taking the time to invest in my body and I am feeling amazing. Also I love Jacquelyn’s personality she feels like a friend;) Thank you so much!

reviews.title: Lifestyle changes
reviews.text: I love this app! I feel like this is so much more than a workout-app, this is a lifestyle app and so useful if you are looking to make lifestyle changes that better you all around. The recipes are so helpful and delicious. I love cooking but sometimes just feel like I’m out of ideas, so I love being able to use these recipes. The wide range of workouts is awesome too, if I’m not feeling great I can stretch or do a gentle barre or Pilates flow. I love that I have the choice of body weight, resistance band options, lighter weights and heavier weight workouts. I can save my favorites, and track everything I do. That green check at the end of the day when I have worked out, is also super motivating.

reviews.title: Love this!
reviews.text: So many great, effective exercise or stretches for everyday! I have had this app for 3 years now and always keep coming back!

reviews.title: Challenging and fun
reviews.text: I don’t really make reviews, but I love this program. I’m a very active person and she does a great job making her workouts challenging. I used this for her prenatal program during pregnancy and am now using her postpartum program. It’s super informative and has helped me a lot postpartum! I also do all of her other workouts and they’re amazing!

reviews.title: Charged for more than knew I agreed to!
reviews.text: I was charged $99 each year for the past two years and didn’t realize it because I signed up to pay $19 for a 21 day challenge and they continued charging me for a membership to the app. Pretty scammy!!!

reviews.title: Easy, reliable
reviews.text: Reliably the best workout app for anything. Morning, evening, energy, stretch, recovery, postpartum, pregnant, literally anything. Such an easy app to use.

reviews.title: Beautiful App
reviews.text: I have fallen in love with this app. As a former gym girlie, I got really tired of being watched or asked questions while I was trying to workout. This app is perfect for anywhere and everywhere. She designs the workouts and all you have to do is follow along.

reviews.title: Best busy mom workouts
reviews.text: Truly I feel like the workouts allow me to get my strength & cardio in without taking too much time. Very effective and fun!!

reviews.title: They erase any comment that isn’t 100% positive
reviews.text: I do love this app, but I don’t like that they erase any comment under their workouts that aren’t 100% positive. They’ve done this multiple times. Even when it’s just constructive criticism or suggestions. Any type of comment that doesn’t fit their agenda is erased. Just be aware.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Will be a fav

reviews.title: So fun!
reviews.text: I’m post partum and wanted to try something new. The workouts are so much fun! I actually look forward to them. I like how they vary in length so even if you don’t have the energy you can pick a short one. She is so knowledgeable about core recovery as well.  I’m seeing results after about a month of doing the workouts 3-5 times a week.  Can you please make a sweatshirt with the Barre Definition app logo??

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I’m sure the program may be great, but I don’t appreciate the way the billing was handled. I never even opted into the free trial because I wasn’t prepared yet and I wanted to wait until I was ready. I never picked a subscription yet. They tried to bill me $149.99. I don’t even know what subscription that would be for because I never opted into a plan or program. Glad I didn’t put my real card on there.

reviews.title: LOVE THIS PROGRAM
reviews.text: I have never stuck with something this long. I’ve been doing her programs for three years, I look forward to them. I have been able to be consistent. Workouts are effective and you don’t have to spend an hour working out to get results. New content introduced consistently to keep you engaged. Absolutely love Jacquelyn!!

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: I love the app, all of the options, and how easy to use it is! Keeps me motivated on days I really need it! ❤️

reviews.title: Workouts for every level
reviews.text: Absolutely love this app and the variety it provides. I’ve always struggled with flexibility, and in a short amount of time I’ve already seen improvements.  Workouts fly by and get your heart rate up even without being high intensity.  Love it!

reviews.title: Short but strong workouts!!
reviews.text: THE app that changed the game. The one that actually makes you look forward to working out. New workout every single day. Programs. Personalized calendars. Love it!

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text:
At 49 I hit a wall and was completely burned out on working out - took a 4 year hiatus basically. After a wake up call at 53 I came across BD on Instagram and decided to the 90 day barre challenge. Day 1 I thought I had no chance of making it to the end. But I kept at it and am addicted. Finished that challenges and now have 4 more going strong. I look forward to the workouts every day. Sometimes I do 6!  I even have a ballet barre now and am learning ballet on BD - a dream I’ve always had!  Jacquelyn is amazing and adorable and there
Is no one else I’d rather work out with.

reviews.title: This fits me
reviews.text: I love barre and Pilates and this is a great blend. I thought it would be weird not being in a studio but this makes it so easy to squeeze in a workout when the day has gotten away from me.

reviews.title: Best Workout Videos
reviews.text: I’ve had this program for a few years. It’s so easy to come back to. Videos are well explained, go at a great pace. Love the variety. There are programs to follow that target specific types of workouts. There are also daily workouts you can select that help take the guess work out of planning your week. Lately, I have been doing strength training workout videos at the gym. I walk the treadmill 15 min and then do a 35-45 min strength training video. So easy, great results!

reviews.title: Great range of time, difficulty, and type of workout!
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for 2 years and I just love it. Jacquelyn is great at giving tips to make sure your body is aligned correctly and performing proper form, and she’s motivational as she goes through each video. I enjoy this app and programs more than others I’ve had because there is a lot of variety and I also love that she gives those alignment tips because I frequently find myself out of form until I hear her little guidance and realize I need to adjust. 

There are also many types of workouts ranging from weights to body weight, Pilates and yoga, and more traditional dance workouts with many reps of refined movements that will burn your muscles in the best way. There are also pregnancy workouts I wish I had had when I was in need of those years ago, but I love that they’re available and accessible.

Workouts are organized by time, (body) area of focus, type of workout, plus the search works well for me to find what I need if I forgot to favorite a specific workout! 

She does show some modifications too, which is helpful for anyone who needs it in general or during phases of recovery or needing to rest various areas.

Can’t say enough good things about this app, I find it well worth the yearly rate.⭐️

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.text: Good workouts, I can tell she is more into cardio than building strength. They certainly can be combined (as is shown in the classes within the app) but there is no true strength muscle growth focus even in the Strength Lab program. Otherwise the app is named appropriately and the classes are challenging and fun.

reviews.title: Exactly what I needed
reviews.text:
I’m so happy to be doing these barre workouts. I knew I needed something flexible I could do from home with 2 young kids. This has been perfect and FUN. My toddler even enjoys joining in because I think she knows it looks like I’m having a good time.

The app has some really helpful calendars and it looks like there are so many workouts and programs with more being added.

I also love that I can pull it up on my Roku tv so it’s easier to see.

reviews.title: I LOVE THE BARRE DEFINITION WORKOUT!
reviews.text: Two years ago, I started working out with Jacquelyn because she had a variety of workouts, for example ballet, weights, pilates, etc. I was 61 years old, had a bilateral knee replacement (both knees at the same time) back in 2017, had my left arm completely reconstructed twice after a Scagg lawnmower fell on top of me in 2010, and had a screw in my left foot after I stepped on a rock and broke it. I worked out in the gym, but never saw improvement in my stomach area, which looked like a tire around my waist. I started with Jacquelyn’s beginning workout and loved them. My husband kept asking me what I was doing. Finally, he asked to workout with me. He loved how he felt when he finished: refreshed with oxygen flowing throughout the body, stronger, more pliable. I now have curves even without sticking to a strict diet. Yes, I need to lose 25 more pounds, but my clothes fit so well now! Thank you, Jacquelyn! I love your positivity, and I love the BEACH scenes!

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Loving it so far

reviews.title: It’s what I needed!
reviews.text: I really love having this app—not for another workout exercises—but the expertise and kindness in the instructor makes this amazing! You can start out where you need to and go to different workouts and levels. I have had a gym membership but wanted to cry every time I went, and I would run out as fast as I could after a workout. I didn’t want to worry about my outfit or my small weight level or feeling lonely at the gym, I just wanted to be stronger. I believe this is going to do that!

reviews.title: Boosted My Strength For Labor!
reviews.text: Barre definition is amazing. I got the app during my third pregnancy to improve my strength and by the time I got to my labor realized I had so much endurance. I wasn’t as exhausted as I was with my first labor and I felt more connected with my body. I loved how each week there was a yoga lesson, pelvic floor exercises and plenty of strength training. This is perfect for pregnant moms looking to build their endurance without over doing it with cardio.

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: Perfect for whatever season I find myself and she is a great instructor with many programs and videos and support to choose from

reviews.title: BEST WORKOUT EVER
reviews.text: Jaqueline naturally knows how to move the body in a way that stretches, opens, strengthens, and empowers, because I am now so much more aware of my body and muscle movement. Her yogi mentality narrates through the exercises elegantly, filling me up with peace and presence. I love the mini meditations and visualizations she walks us through as she radiates abundance and goodwill. Love the app, love Jaqueline, and I love working out with her kind of motivation. Thank you for all you do 💝🌹💓

reviews.title: Hard to manage subscription
reviews.text: It’s not that easy to cancel, you’d think it’s just one button but no, you have to jump hoops and write request emails in 2026 to actually make decisions about your money.

reviews.title: Gentle program is great for knee recovery
reviews.text: I am a fairly active person but I hurt my knee from overuse and was really struggling to get it to heal because I kept irritating it with my various activities.  I was looking for something that worked the legs without damaging the knee, and the Gentle section in the 90 day program was just what I needed!  I started in January and even though I didn't do the workouts every day I was healed enough to do my "usual" (biking, running, ice hockey) after about a month.  I still go back to the Gentle routines because they are so good - fast and effective but I'm not so sore from them that I can't do something else the next day (or sometimes even later that same day).  Thank you!!!

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: The combination of the workouts is just what I was looking for! They make me feel so good afterwards. Love the quick workouts & the monthly challenges.

reviews.title: The best workout app!
reviews.text: I adore this app. It is the first workout app/program I have not only stuck with, but genuinely *enjoy*. I am working out six days per week and LOVE IT. I am leaner, stronger, and more confident. Jacqueline is the best trainer!!

reviews.title: The best investment!
reviews.text: As a busy working mom, these workouts are so effective and practical! I’m in the best shape of my life and finally have a consistent routine. Love it!

reviews.title: Most consistent I’ve ever been
reviews.text: Huge variety of workouts for most levels. Highly recommend for someone who needs help with consistency. I’m 4 months in and my body has seen huge changes even with diet fluctuations.

reviews.title: Perfect

reviews.title: Just what I needed
reviews.text: I had neck surgery a year ago, an ACDF so I have a titanium disc in my neck. I couldn’t work out for a while and got really out of shape. I had no motivation. Everything was too hard and I just couldn’t do it. I have started the 28 day beginner here and I am actually doing it. It’s easy enough I can do it but also just challenging enough to make me feel a burn and feel good about myself. Once I’m done with the 28 day beginner I look forward to doing another more challenging work out plan from her! Thank you!

reviews.title: Commit to it!
reviews.text: Comprehensive and educational application! So many resources and easy to follow- it is organized and the workouts are realistic! Definitely challenging, there’s a variety of categories and I just moved from prenatal to postal exercises!

reviews.title: Love everything about this app!
reviews.text: I love everything about this app: the workouts, the organization and the recipes. The workouts are so different and always have me feeling accomplished when I’m done! I love that Jacqueline has guests in her workouts to change them up and give their expertise! Keep it up!

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I am 45, an ex ballerina with a TBI and metal rod in my left femur. Balance and coordination have become an issue for me but working with this program has been such a delight because I feel like not only am I getting stronger but I am doing ballet postures I haven’t done in years!!! It makes me feel so good. Along with a calorie deficit -I am down 5 points on 2 weeks. And my posture is so much better already. I am loving this.

reviews.title: Best barre/ pilates app hands down!
reviews.text: I have been using this app and doing these workouts for a couple years now and I’m still as obsessed as I was the first day I tried! I have recommended a bunch of my friends to use it and they all love it as well. It is suitable for all stages of workouts (beginners, medium, advanced and even PREGNANT) it’s seriously amazing and I Cannot recommend this app enough. Jacquelyn is so sweet and you can tell she really cares about her users! 100/10 recommend ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
